---
title: "selection_s"
format: html
---

`selection_s` is an optional MAF-dependent effect-scale policy:

```text
q_j(S) = [2 p_j (1-p_j)]^(S+1)
```

`NULL` means no MAF scaling. A finite value is fixed scaling, while `-1`
explicitly requests a scale numerically equal to one. Sampled `selection_s` is
available only on validated ST routes; sampled MT `selection_s` is unsupported.

MAF provenance and alignment are recorded. Reference-panel fallback requires
explicit permission. MAF-derived annotations may coexist with `selection_s`,
but the overlap is reported because it can confound probability and variance
effects.
